<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 27:23">Targ. Job XXVII, 23</cite>.—
Ḥull. 63ᵃ ההוא … כרבא וש׳ one (bird raḥam) sat among cabbage and whistled.

Ib. יתיב אמידי ושָׁרֵיק רקרק Ar. (ed. ועביד שרקרק, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes 40, 50) sits on some object (not on the ground), and sings raḳraḳ; אי יתיב אערעא ושריק וכ׳ when it sits on the ground and sings, the Messiah will come; Yalk. Lev. 537.
